Short description: Missing receipts from WMS to RMS for Primark Depot 10966
Resolution Note: Event Description: Missing receipts from WMS to RMS for Primark Depot 10966 Root Cause Category: Integration Failure Root Cause Subcategory: Message Broker / Interface Delay Detailed Root Cause Analysis: A network timeout between the Warehouse Management System (WMS) and the Retail Management System (RMS) middleware caused the outbound receipt messages to stall in the transactional integration layer instead of pushing to the host system. Action Taken: Reprocessed the pending receipt messages from the WMS outbound interface table. Confirmed successful delivery and validation inside RMS. Resolution Type: Data Reprocessing Preventive Action: Set up automated infrastructure alerts to notify the middleware team if an outbound payload remains in a "Pending" status for more than 15 minutes.

Short description: Exception raised for Backout queue 1161 -  ESB.RMS.RECEIPTS.IQ.BAK
Resolution Note: Event Description: Exception raised for Backout queue 1161 - ESB.RMS.RECEIPTS.IQ.BAK Root Cause Category: Middleware / ESB Exception Root Cause Subcategory: Data Validation / Schema Mismatch Detailed Root Cause Analysis: An incoming receipt message contained an invalid date-time format in the header wrapper, causing the Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) parser to reject the file and route it to the backout queue (BAK) to avoid blocking the main message queue. Action Taken: Corrected the date-time format in the payload directly via the ESB message management console and re-queued the message for successful execution. Resolution Type: Data Correction & Re-queue Preventive Action: Update upstream mapping code in the WMS system to guarantee strict formatting compliance before message delivery.

Short description: New pallet was generated by VP. This pallet can generate error closing trailer.
Resolution Note: Event Description: New pallet was generated by VP. This pallet can generate error closing trailer. Root Cause Category: Application Logic / Software Bug Root Cause Subcategory: System State Mismatch Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The Voice Picking (VP) system allowed a warehouse operator to generate and associate a new pallet ID to a trailer session that had already been marked as 'Finalized', resulting in a structural conflict that blocks the trailer closure workflow in the WMS. Action Taken: Executed a database backend script to safely un-link the orphaned pallet ID from the finalized trailer record and assigned it to a standard open staging lane. Resolution Type: Backend Database Modification Preventive Action: Deploy an application patch to the Voice Picking system that restricts new pallet generation on any trailer session once it transitions past the active loading state.

Short description: Islip Depot - We notice that there is an issue with lag for store emails. For example the order for store 534 inserted into JDA at 15:06 but we got the email at
Resolution Note: Event Description: Islip Depot - We notice that there is an issue with lag for store emails. For example the order for store 534 inserted into JDA at 15:06 but we got the email at [Delayed] Root Cause Category: Infrastructure / Email Gateway Root Cause Subcategory: Server Resource Contention Detailed Root Cause Analysis: A massive spike in system-generated client orders caused a bottleneck within the local mail server's SMTP relay pool, resulting in processing latency for outward-bound store notifications coming out of JDA. Action Taken: Restarted the SMTP relay services and allocated additional temporary CPU allocation to clear out the accumulated outbound message queue. Resolution Type: Infrastructure Service Optimization Preventive Action: Implement load balancing for the notification gateway and increase the concurrent thread pool limit during high-volume operational shifts.

Short description: Exception raised for Backout queue PI368 -  ESB.STRATIFICATION.PI368PO.IQ.BAK
Resolution Note: Event Description: Exception raised for Backout queue PI368 - ESB.STRATIFICATION.PI368PO.IQ.BAK Root Cause Category: Middleware / ESB Exception Root Cause Subcategory: Missing Reference Data Detailed Root Cause Analysis: A Purchase Order (PO) stratification payload failed validation and was routed to the backout queue because the master Vendor ID supplied in the payload did not exist in the host core database. Action Taken: Set up the missing Vendor ID within the master database registry and manually triggered the re-processing of the failed payload from the backout console. Resolution Type: Master Data Sync Preventive Action: Implement validation rules in the upstream ordering system to block PO generation if the associated Vendor record is unverified or missing.

Short description: We would like to report an GRN that has unit discrepancy issues. We have confirmed a total of 2578 units [out of a total of 2585], leaving only 7 cartons as bei
Resolution Note: Event Description: We would like to report an GRN that has unit discrepancy issues. We have confirmed a total of 2578 units [out of a total of 2585], leaving only 7 cartons as being [short] Root Cause Category: Inventory / Receiving Discrepancy Root Cause Subcategory: Physical vs System Count Mismatch Detailed Root Cause Analysis: A discrepancy occurred during the Goods Received Note (GRN) matching phase because a supplier short-shipment of 7 physical cartons was missed during the initial physical dock intake. Action Taken: Adjusted the GRN entry inside the system to reflect the true verified quantity of 2578 units and initiated an official supplier shortage recovery claim. Resolution Type: Inventory Record Adjustment Preventive Action: Retrain the intake yard team on the application of strict blind-counting procedures during inbound trailer processing.

Short description: TC: depo RSDL - missing 1 box for ADVANCED order 20984990
Resolution Note: Event Description: TC: depo RSDL - missing 1 box for ADVANCED order 20984990 Root Cause Category: Operational / Warehouse Floor Root Cause Subcategory: Short Pick / Misplaced Item Detailed Root Cause Analysis: During the order assembly for advanced order 20984990, an operator inadvertently left one packed box behind at pick location grid A-12 due to a misread pick list ticket. Action Taken: Conducted a physical search of the pick grid, retrieved the misplaced box, moved it directly to the active staging line, and marked the order status as fully complete. Resolution Type: Physical Rectification Preventive Action: Enable mandatory barcode configuration rules requiring pickers to scan each individual container validation code before transitioning orders to staging.

Short description: Islip 963 - trailer CTS19969 stuck on dock door 65G
Resolution Note: Event Description: Islip 963 - trailer CTS19969 stuck on dock door 65G Root Cause Category: Application Logic / WMS Lock Root Cause Subcategory: Database Thread Deadlock Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Trailer CTS19969 became stuck at dock door 65G within JDA due to an application database deadlock that occurred when two users concurrently attempted to update the same shipping manifest record. Action Taken: Terminated the deadlocked database process thread and cleared the active lock flags via database access tools to free up the trailer status. Resolution Type: Database Lock Release Preventive Action: Optimize table index properties and review transaction isolation settings for the dock door assignment software module.

Short description: OSTH - Work Order Cancelation, Both of the WO: 81031 and 81230 are showing in your WMS and they are reserving stock causing stock sync issue. Please cancel them
Resolution Note: Event Description: OSTH - Work Order Cancelation, Both of the WO: 81031 and 81230 are showing in your WMS and they are reserving stock causing stock sync issue. Please cancel them Root Cause Category: Inventory Sync / Work Order Management Root Cause Subcategory: Stale Reservation Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Work orders 81031 and 81230 were deleted in the host planning software, but the corresponding cancellation message was dropped before execution in WMS, leaving the physical inventory erroneously locked. Action Taken: Manually flagged the status of work orders 81031 and 81230 as "Cancelled" in the WMS UI to release the inventory allocation and ran an on-demand stock synchronization job. Resolution Type: Manual System Override Preventive Action: Implement a automated nightly data health check script designed to catch and cancel orphaned inventory allocations between systems.

Short description: 343 Naas Depot  pallet process failure at dock door 23  JDA( The specified location is currently full )
Resolution Note: Event Description: 343 Naas Depot pallet process failure at dock door 23 JDA( The specified location is currently full ) Root Cause Category: WMS Configuration / Putaway Logic Root Cause Subcategory: Capacity Constraint Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The process failed because the system reached the maximum item volume threshold set in JDA for dock door 23, blocking the allocation of new pallets. Action Taken: Cleared processed pallets from the physical dock door layout to open floor grids and forced a capacity recalculation refresh for door 23 in the system. Resolution Type: Space Clearing & System Refresh Preventive Action: Adjust location volumetric profiles inside JDA for critical high-volume dock doors and activate overflow staging logic fields.

Short description: RSDL - MULTIPICKLIST ISSUE 2627702 & 2628481
Resolution Note: Event Description: RSDL - MULTIPICKLIST ISSUE 2627702 & 2628481 Root Cause Category: Application Logic / WMS Bug Root Cause Subcategory: Allocation / Picklist Generation Error Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The multi-pick list generation failed due to a duplicate primary key sequence constraint violation in the staging tables when picking tasks for orders 2627702 and 2628481 were simultaneously processed by the server. Action Taken: Cleared the locked pick sequence flags from the WMS allocation tables and manually regenerated the multi-pick lists for both orders. Resolution Type: System Record Correction Preventive Action: Deploy an application patch to serialize multi-pick list generation requests within the message queue to avoid race conditions.

Short description: Please check that all files have alligned for order B12957734. ASN did not transmit for this PO onto our WMS. Manual pack was created 95500000000108354  to rece
Resolution Note: Event Description: Please check that all files have alligned for order B12957734. ASN did not transmit for this PO onto our WMS. Manual pack was created 95500000000108354 to rece Root Cause Category: Integration Failure Root Cause Subcategory: EDI / IDoc Transmission Failure Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The inbound Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) message for order B12957734 dropped at the middleware gateway because the file payload size exceeded standard buffer limits set on the EDI adapter. Action Taken: Confirmed that manual pack 95500000000108354 successfully permitted receiving. Manually reconciled the outstanding system ASN status to 'Processed' to align host and WMS inventory blocks. Resolution Type: Manual Data Alignment Preventive Action: Increase the packet buffer threshold on the EDI integration adapter and set up automatic reprocessing for large ASN payloads.

Short description: TC. - ICT order 21114402 not fully allocated.
Resolution Note: Event Description: TC. - ICT order 21114402 not fully allocated. Root Cause Category: Inventory / Allocation Logic Root Cause Subcategory: Soft Allocation Lock Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Inter-Company Transfer (ICT) order 21114402 did not fully allocate because 15 units of the required SKU were tied up in a "Soft Lock" state by an expired e-commerce reservation session that failed to auto-release. Action Taken: Cleared the stale soft allocation lock via the database management utility and manually re-ran the allocation wave for the remaining lines of ICT order 21114402. Resolution Type: Inventory Allocation Release Preventive Action: Reduce the system expiry time limit for pending order reservations to automatically free up uncommitted inventory faster.

Short description: Depot RSDL/OOST In VocalPoint (Timewise) Operators get stuck in System when assigned to Pallet Pick - task
Resolution Note: Event Description: Depot RSDL/OOST In VocalPoint (Timewise) Operators get stuck in System when assigned to Pallet Pick - task Root Cause Category: Infrastructure / Voice System Integration Root Cause Subcategory: Session Hang / Device Timeout Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Operators became stuck because the VocalPoint middleware application experienced a socket timeout when trying to validate the dynamic location check-digit for Pallet Pick tasks against the backend database. Action Taken: Terminated the hanging operator sessions on the VocalPoint application console and recycled the voice terminal communication ports. Resolution Type: Session Reset Preventive Action: Optimize database query execution plans for location validation endpoints to ensure response times remain under 200ms.

Short description: TC - VP is not archiving data since 15.08.2025
Resolution Note: Event Description: TC - VP is not archiving data since 15.08.2025 Root Cause Category: Database Management / Scheduled Jobs Root Cause Subcategory: Folder Access Permissions Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The VocalPoint (VP) data archiving cron job has been failing silently since August 15, 2025, due to a "Permission Denied" error on the target network storage directory following an infrastructure security group update. Action Taken: Restored write permissions for the archiving service account on the destination network path and manually executed the archive backlog scripts to clear old records. Resolution Type: Service Permission Correction Preventive Action: Integrate automated email alerts into the archiving script framework to instantly flag any future execution failures.

Short description: These PO's were sent to advance supply chain for reprocessing to split cartons in half but PO's were not doubled. Please can the PO's be increased as follows:
Resolution Note: Event Description: These PO's were sent to advance supply chain for reprocessing to split cartons in half but PO's were not doubled. Please can the PO's be increased as follows: Root Cause Category: System Configuration / Data Processing Error Root Cause Subcategory: Processing Flow Error Detailed Supply Chain Analysis: During the reprocessing phase, the automated carton-split script split the packing structures physically but failed to double the total units/cartons field inside the system PO table due to an unadjusted quantity cap constraint. Action Taken: Manually updated the target PO quantities upwards using the order maintenance interface to accurately reflect the split-carton counts provided. Resolution Type: Manual Quantity Updation Preventive Action: Update the carton-split script's logic bounds to allow variable quantity adjustments without tripping safe-cap limits.

Short description: RSDL - Pallet with exceeded attempts / already loaded onto trailer.
Resolution Note: Event Description: RSDL - Pallet with exceeded attempts / already loaded onto trailer. Root Cause Category: RF Scanning / WMS State Error Root Cause Subcategory: Out-of-Sync Scanning State Detailed Root Cause Analysis: An RF gun scanning loop occurred because an operator scanned a pallet ID twice. The first scan successfully associated it to the trailer, but the second scan triggered an "already loaded" error and locked the pallet state in a buffer loop. Action Taken: Reset the status of the affected pallet record in the WMS from 'In-Transit-Lock' back to 'Loaded' to accurately match the physical trailer manifest. Resolution Type: State Field Reset Preventive Action: Enhance the RF gun scanning interface logic to gracefully ignore double-scans of the same item within a 3-second window instead of throwing an error loop.

Short description: Roosendaal Archive WMS has failed to output Order Details on Sunday. Please can you recover this data for us and locate what the issue was that caused this to n
Resolution Note: Event Description: Roosendaal Archive WMS has failed to output Order Details on Sunday. Please can you recover this data for us and locate what the issue was that caused this to n Root Cause Category: Database Management / Scheduled Jobs Root Cause Subcategory: Weekly Maintenance Window Conflict Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The Roosendaal Archive WMS reporting task failed to output the Order Details because its scheduled run time overlapped directly with a routine IT infrastructure database backup, locking out access to the source tables. Action Taken: Manually re-triggered the Sunday Order Details extraction routine. Verified that the data output file was correctly formatted and delivered to the archive repository. Resolution Type: Scheduled Job Reprocessing Preventive Action: Reschedule the Sunday Archive WMS reporting job to run two hours later to completely clear the system backup window.

Short description: When I try to go into different options in TMS QA I got all the time the same message "User Not Authorized".
Resolution Note: Event Description: When I try to go into different options in TMS QA I got all the time the same message "User Not Authorized". Root Cause Category: Identity & Access Management (IAM) Root Cause Subcategory: Security Profile / Role Expiration Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The user received "User Not Authorized" errors in TMS QA because their QA user profile security token expired, or their mapped user group role was wiped out during a recent environment synchronization refresh from Production. Action Taken: Re-applied the necessary QA Transport Operator roles to the user's profile and requested a local cache clearance. Confirmed access was restored. Resolution Type: User Permissions Restoration Preventive Action: Standardize the QA refresh scripts to preserve non-production active user profile assignments during cross-environment syncs.

Short description: TC - Oosterhout - pallet 781805  stuck systematically in two transports in VP
Resolution Note: Event Description: TC - Oosterhout - pallet 781805 stuck systematically in two transports in VP Root Cause Category: Application Logic / Software Bug Root Cause Subcategory: Concurrent Task Allocation Error Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Pallet 781805 became locked because an asynchronous database latency between the WMS and VocalPoint (VP) allowed the same pallet ID to be assigned to two separate active transport tasks simultaneously. Action Taken: Aborted both conflicting tasks via the VocalPoint management panel, reset the pallet status field to 'Staged', and generated a single clean transport task. Resolution Type: Task Reset & Re-assignment Preventive Action: Modify the task allocation script to execute a synchronous check on the pallet state prior to initiating a new transport thread.

Short description: Naas Depot - storage error
Resolution Note: Event Description: Naas Depot - storage error Root Cause Category: WMS Configuration Root Cause Subcategory: Location Allocation / Capacity Limit Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The storage error was triggered during a putaway attempt because the target zone profile was configured with an incorrect maximum volumetric capacity limit, causing the system to reject standard-sized pallets. Action Taken: Corrected the dimensions and maximum weight parameters for the affected zone in the location master matrix and forced a recalculation. Resolution Type: System Configuration Update Preventive Action: Schedule a quarterly automated audit of zone configuration profiles across Naas Depot to ensure parameters match physical bay constraints.

Short description: Discrepancies stock loss week 11, -50 again on report. Please see yellow lines in attached file.
Resolution Note: Event Description: Discrepancies stock loss week 11, -50 again on report. Please see yellow lines in attached file. Root Cause Category: Data Processing / Reporting Error Root Cause Subcategory: Stale Inventory Ledger / Sync Failure Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The recurring -50 unit stock loss discrepancy on the report was caused by a delayed inventory adjustment file from a virtual returns location that failed to upload to the reporting schema before the weekly ledger closure. Action Taken: Manually triggered a historical reconciliation job to process the outstanding adjustment payload, which eliminated the -50 variance. Resolution Type: Manual Data Reconciliation Preventive Action: Shift the weekly stock reporting pipeline execution by 12 hours to guarantee all lagging return transactions are successfully committed.

Short description: I have identified an issue in Roosendaal with out Pick Details extracts. The figures do not match with what is being reported by depot & pick activity in WMS.
Resolution Note: Event Description: I have identified an issue in Roosendaal with out Pick Details extracts. The figures do not match with what is being reported by depot & pick activity in WMS. Root Cause Category: Data Extraction / Integration Failure Root Cause Subcategory: Extraction Script Filter Error Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The Pick Details extracts did not match actual warehouse activity because a hardcoded date filter in the export script utilized a fixed time zone offset that inadvertently omitted the final hour of daily pick tasks. Action Taken: Updated the extraction script to reference unified UTC timestamps and re-exported the historical datasets to align perfectly with the depot metrics. Resolution Type: Code/Script Adjustment Preventive Action: Implement automated record-count validation checks between the source WMS tables and the generated export files before data transmission.

Short description: Trailer completion error - OS99BX
Resolution Note: Event Description: Trailer completion error - OS99BX Root Cause Category: Application Logic / Validation Constraint Root Cause Subcategory: Open Task Conflict Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Trailer OS99BX failed to close because an operator left an individual carton in an unconfirmed 'Short Pick' status inside an open pick wave directly mapped to this trailer's shipping manifest. Action Taken: Reconciled the orphaned carton status to 'Short-Cancelled' after confirming physical absence, allowing the trailer completion transaction to process cleanly. Resolution Type: Manifest Reconciliation Preventive Action: Add a validation UI warning list that dynamically displays any open pick tasks blocking a trailer closure when a supervisor initiates a manifest wrap-up.

Event Description: 343 Naas Depot - FW: D12874706-210288003-RITM0181140 Root Cause Category: Integration Failure Root Cause Subcategory: Middleware Message Block Detailed Root Cause Analysis: This incident (forwarded via RITM0181140) was triggered by a corrupted delivery block flag inside the enterprise service middleware layer, which stalled the downstream execution of an entire order pick wave for Depot 343. Action Taken: Cleared the invalid block flag using backend database access tools and manually re-pushed the transaction payload directly to the depot's active WMS execution queue. Resolution Type: Interface Message Clearance Preventive Action: Establish a automated error-handling policy in the middleware to auto-drop or alert on unvalidated delivery block flags after 10 minutes of inactivity.

Short description: RSDL WMS-  Orders for store 203 - order 300178407 ;store 225 order 300178432 unable to release.
Resolution Note: Event Description: RSDL WMS- Orders for store 203 - order 300178407 ;store 225 order 300178432 unable to release. Root Cause Category: Inventory Allocation / Credit Lock Root Cause Subcategory: Hard Allocation Constraint Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Orders 300178407 and 300178432 were blocked from releasing to the floor due to a system allocation lock caused by an unexpected stock shortage on a shared high-demand SKU requested by both stores. Action Taken: Conducted an emergency inventory allocation override to source the missing items from an alternative bulk reserve grid, releasing both orders for processing. Resolution Type: Stock Re-allocation Preventive Action: Configure order release parameters to allow for partial order processing for priority retail stores rather than imposing a hard release block.

Short description: Islip Depot 963 - Unable to cancel pending shipment line due to error 510
Resolution Note: Event Description: Islip Depot 963 - Unable to cancel pending shipment line due to error 510 Root Cause Category: Application Logic / State Mismatch Root Cause Subcategory: Status Synchronization Lock Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Error 510 occurred because a user attempted to cancel a pending shipment line that had already transitioned to an active 'Picking' status on an operator's RF scanning gun terminal, creating a state conflict. Action Taken: Terminated the active pick assignment on the warehouse operator's profile, reverted the line state back to 'Staged', and completed the cancellation. Resolution Type: Status Fields Override Preventive Action: Refine the system's error handling to return an informative message identifying the specific user or terminal holding the active allocation lock.

Resolution Note: Event Description: Please assign this Request to the TCS Service Wrap team for Blue Yonder TMS. 2) Service Wrap team: Please raise a ticket with BY for the following:As p Root Cause Category: Vendor Application Failure Root Cause Subcategory: SaaS / Core Product Bug Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The underlying issue involved a memory leak within the native Blue Yonder TMS optimization engine routing module, leading to intermittent API dropouts for automated third-party carrier tendering. Action Taken: Routed the incident to the Service Wrap team to escalate a priority ticket to Blue Yonder. BY engineers applied a software patch to clear the server stack memory and stabilize the gateway. Resolution Type: Vendor Software Patch Deployment Preventive Action: Configure a scheduled automated service recycle for the BY TMS optimization component during off-peak operational maintenance windows.

Short description: Exception raised for Backout queue 1161 -  ESB.RMS.RECEIPTS.IQ.BAK
Resolution Note: Event Description: Exception raised for Backout queue 1161 - ESB.RMS.RECEIPTS.IQ.BAK Root Cause Category: Middleware / ESB Exception Root Cause Subcategory: Character Encoding / Data Truncation Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The receipt message failed to parse and dropped into backout queue 1161 because the payload contained an un-escaped special character within the delivery notes tag, breaking the XML validation schema. Action Taken: Manually removed the invalid special character from the raw message text via the ESB queue utility browser and successfully re-queued the transaction payload. Resolution Type: Payload Modification & Re-queue Preventive Action: Deploy an input sanitization script at the outbound WMS serialization layer to strip or escape unauthorized characters prior to file transfer.

Short description: 343 Naas depot  - Iberian Secondary Order placed through ROI Depot ( sotres not serviced by Ireland)
Resolution Note: Event Description: 343 Naas depot - Iberian Secondary Order placed through ROI Depot ( stores not serviced by Ireland) Root Cause Category: Order Management / Routing Error Root Cause Subcategory: Incorrect Sourcing Rules Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The Iberian Secondary Order was misrouted to the Republic of Ireland (ROI) Depot 343 instead of the continental hub due to an outdated store-to-depot mapping matrix in the ERP master data. Action Taken: Canceled the misrouted order lines in the Naas WMS to free up local inventory allocations and manually re-injected the order to the correct continental depot system. Resolution Type: Order Re-routing & Cancellation Preventive Action: Update the global supply chain routing rules inside the ERP to prevent non-serviced region stores from placing orders against the Ireland depot profile.

Short description: % Free Space is too low IEDU2LVPAPP401
Resolution Note: Event Description: % Free Space is too low IEDU2LVPAPP401 Root Cause Category: Infrastructure / Server Management Root Cause Subcategory: Disk Space Saturation Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Server IEDU2LVPAPP401 (VocalPoint Application server) ran low on storage because old application trace logs (.trc) and transactional debugging files failed to auto-purge. Action Taken: Purged all system log files older than 14 days and cleared the temporary directory to reclaim 45GB of disk space. Resolution Type: Disk Space Cleanup Preventive Action: Adjust the automated log retention policy configuration to archive and delete logs every 7 days instead of monthly.

Short description: 343 Naas Depot issue with PUT AWAY  MRT 5182 / 5217
Resolution Note: Event Description: 343 Naas Depot issue with PUT AWAY MRT 5182 / 5217 Root Cause Category: WMS Configuration / Putaway Logic Root Cause Subcategory: Equipment / Location Class Mismatch Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Putaway tasks for Mass Stock Receipts (MRT) 5182 and 5217 threw system errors because the target storage rack locations were configured with high-reach forklift restrictions that conflicted with the designated operator equipment profile. Action Taken: Overrode the location constraint flags in the WMS for the affected tasks, allowing the operators to execute alternative low-bay putaways. Resolution Type: Putaway Constraint Override Preventive Action: Review and align equipment class restrictions within the WMS zone master configuration matrix.

Short description: Paul / 966/ Depot Roosendaal Users unable to open Timewise Business Analytics, Server(connection) seems down
Resolution Note: Event Description: Paul / 966/ Depot Roosendaal Users unable to open Timewise Business Analytics, Server(connection) seems down Root Cause Category: Network & Infrastructure Root Cause Subcategory: Service Unavailability / Web Service Crash Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Users could not establish a connection with Timewise Business Analytics because the core application IIS service crashed on the host server following an automatic security definition update. Action Taken: Restarted the affected web application services and validated connectivity from terminal workstations. Resolution Type: Service Restart Preventive Action: Coordinate security update installation windows exclusively during planned maintenance schedules to prevent operational runtime dropouts.

Short description: Naas Depot - Application hanging when cancelling picks
Resolution Note: Event Description: Naas Depot - Application hanging when cancelling picks Root Cause Category: Application Performance Root Cause Subcategory: Database Resource Contention / Thread Lock Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The pick cancellation workflow caused the UI application to hang because the delete script was waiting on an unindexed table lock held by an active heavy wave allocation process. Action Taken: Terminated the blocking background process thread and killed the hung user sessions to restore standard UI functionality. Resolution Type: Session and Thread Termination Preventive Action: Introduce database index improvements on the primary picking transaction tables to minimize query execution delays.

Short description: 343 Naas Depot -  W/O 96150 to be  cancelled  at Naas Prod
Resolution Note: Event Description: 343 Naas Depot - W/O 96150 to be cancelled at Naas Prod Root Cause Category: Work Order Management Root Cause Subcategory: Manual Cancellation Request Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Work Order (W/O) 96150 needed cancellation in the Production environment due to a business operational change where the specific promotional stock build was no longer required. Action Taken: Executed the cancellation routine for W/O 96150 via the WMS user interface and successfully de-allocated all associated inventory. Resolution Type: Manual Administrative Action Preventive Action: Standardize corporate operational workflows to ensure cancellation requests are processed at the host ERP level to trigger downstream integration flows automatically.

Short description: Replenishments completed in VocalPoint are errored in WMS Red Prairie Download Viewer.
Resolution Note: Event Description: Replenishments completed in VocalPoint are errored in WMS Red Prairie Download Viewer. Root Cause Category: Integration Failure Root Cause Subcategory: Interface Desynchronization Detailed Root Cause Analysis: VocalPoint replenishment confirmations errored out within the RedPrairie Download Viewer because the transaction payload included an empty "Operator ID" field that violated a strict null-constraint check. Action Taken: Modified the errored records within the RedPrairie landing table to insert a fallback default operator code, then forced the interface processor to reload. Resolution Type: Interface Data Correction Preventive Action: Update the VocalPoint outbound schema settings to enforce the presence of an Operator ID tag before dispatching data.

Short description: Exception raised for Backout queue PI442 -  ESB.LABELSUP.ORDER.IQ.BAK
Resolution Note: Event Description: Exception raised for Backout queue PI442 - ESB.LABELSUP.ORDER.IQ.BAK Root Cause Category: Middleware / ESB Exception Root Cause Subcategory: Parsing Error / Invalid Payload XML Detailed Root Cause Analysis: The ESB.LABELSUP.ORDER integration route pushed messages into the backout queue because an order record contained a malformed nested XML tag within the label supply request structure. Action Taken: Reconstructed the broken XML tag structure using the ESB administrative tool and pushed the message back into the active processing queue. Resolution Type: Payload Re-queuing Preventive Action: Introduce a schema validation layer on the originating order management system to capture formatting faults before they hit the ESB.

Short description: TC - Roosendaal: In WO 88953 stock was picked into CONVOUT, due to this receiving 211506428 is impossible
Resolution Note: Event Description: TC - Roosendaal: In WO 88953 stock was picked into CONVOUT, due to this receiving 211506428 is impossible Root Cause Category: Inventory State Conflict Root Cause Subcategory: Location Type Mismatch Detailed Root Cause Analysis: In Work Order (WO) 88953, inventory was mistakenly dropped into the 'CONVOUT' (Conveyor Outbound) physical location profile, which blocked the inbound receiving subsystem 211506428 from validating and claiming the inventory. Action Taken: Programmatically moved the stock allocation out of the outbound conveyor lane back to a standard staging grid using WMS terminal functions, unblocking the receiving pipeline. Resolution Type: Inventory Location Correction Preventive Action: Configure system barriers to prevent workers from depositing internal work order stock into dedicated external shipping lanes.

Short description: RSDL Depot - 840125 - Loaded in jda but not in VP.
Resolution Note: Event Description: RSDL Depot - 840125 - Loaded in jda but not in VP. Root Cause Category: Data Desynchronization Root Cause Subcategory: Missing Middleware Event Trigger Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Pallet 840125 reflects a status of "Loaded" within JDA WMS, but failed to update inside VocalPoint (VP) because the event-driven trigger message dropped during an internal system queue swap. Action Taken: Manually executed an on-demand synchronization update via the interface console to accurately reflect the "Loaded" state within the VocalPoint application ledger. Resolution Type: Manual Data Sync Preventive Action: Create a real-time reconciliation monitor that auto-flags discrepancies if an asset state diverges between JDA and VP for longer than 5 minutes.

Resolution Note: Event Description: Hi. Short description: Islip Depot 963 - Shipped amount bigger than ordered, store 481 order 100323344
Resolution Note: Event Description: Islip Depot 963 - Shipped amount bigger than ordered, store 481 order 100323344 Root Cause Category: Inventory / Shipping Discrepancy Root Cause Subcategory: Over-allocation / Unit of Measure Mismatch Detailed Root Cause Analysis: Order 100323344 for store 481 experienced a discrepancy because a warehouse picker scanned an entire outer bulk pack as an individual product unit, expanding the system's shipped allocation relative to the physical load. Action Taken: Adjusted the dispatch documentation prior to final trailer manifest closure to lock in the true physical quantity and aligned customer billing modules.
